observed_event: Network connection refusals and some memory kills occurred during transfer or Salmon execution
root_cause_or_interpretation: Infrastructure and resource failures, not biological exclusions
correction_or_disposition: Targeted retries preserved partial downloads; scientific inclusion is decided by complete receipts, not Slurm history
scientific_impact: No run may be excluded because it was inconvenient to compute

observed_event: Each OCM was solved independently despite an all60 label
root_cause_or_interpretation: The runner created one-condition CARNIVAL problems, so it was not pooled multi-condition inference
correction_or_disposition: Retain only as independent single-sample sensitivity; supersede with a true multi-condition Data build
scientific_impact: Old results cannot answer pooled-versus-cohort joint inference

observed_event: Raw solver lambda was initially compared across unequal condition counts
root_cause_or_interpretation: CORNETO sums condition fit terms; the intended reported objective used mean fit
correction_or_disposition: Use lambda_solver equals n times lambda_reported and record both; keep early runs as diagnostics
scientific_impact: Unscaled runs are not comparable across n

observed_event: Some receipts contained Gurobi session-cap errors despite scheduler completion
root_cause_or_interpretation: Concurrent WLS sessions exceeded the licence baseline
evidence_source: Original and repaired receipt provenance recorded in the final grid summary
correction_or_disposition: Slurm COMPLETED is not scientific success; only repaired receipt-valid grids are interpreted

observed_event: Six samples hit the session cap and one mathematical optimum selected no edges
root_cause_or_interpretation: Infrastructure errors and an empty optimum require separate fail-closed states
correction_or_disposition: Serially retry session failures; retain zero-edge sample as blocked_no_selected_edges
scientific_impact: An empty selected network is not evidence of biological inactivity

observed_event: Rank 2 has higher pooled cophenetic and silhouette scores than rank 3
root_cause_or_interpretation: Rank 3 was selected for comparability with an existing integration, not as the data optimum
correction_or_disposition: Report rank 3 as a fixed anchor and rank 2 as a counter-result/sensitivity
scientific_impact: Do not name rank-3 clusters as three biological subtypes

observed_event: The published output is present, but its expression-plus-growth input resolves to an absent author-local path
root_cause_or_interpretation: Exact numerical regeneration is not possible from the public repository snapshot
correction_or_disposition: Audit code, model fingerprint and outputs; run separate toy/global/joint tests
scientific_impact: Do not call the audit an exact reproduction of the 49 OCM models

observed_event: No exact OCM-level AUC, raw GI50 or cumulative paclitaxel exposure rows passed the frozen public-data boundary
root_cause_or_interpretation: Required outcome/exposure data are absent; proxies do not identify the estimands
correction_or_disposition: Keep discovery response-blind and block association/CV until exact tables pass the intake gate
scientific_impact: No drug-response, intrinsic-resistance or acquired-resistance claim is estimable

observed_event: A strict decoded-name predicate reported biomass_human_present false while the pinned SBML ID was R_biomass_human
root_cause_or_interpretation: Identifier normalisation mismatch, not an absent biomass reaction
correction_or_disposition: Use the actual biomass_sbml_ids field and pinned SHA; preserve the old boolean as a known receipt caveat
scientific_impact: Do not infer model invalidity from the legacy helper boolean
